monsterAbilities.name: Battle Mending
monsterAbilities.flavorMarkdown: *Light travels from the healer’s shaking hands into another body, leaving the healer visibly diminished.*
monsterAbilities.rulesMarkdown:
One visible adjacent living creature; free hand required. Pay the printed life cost first, bypassing resistance, and remain above 0 HP. A player controller rolls the creature’s printed healing attribute for its printed HP outcomes. For a hostile NPC healing an ally, ask a player to make that same creature-attribute roll, including its applicable Boons/Banes. The DA still chooses its action and target; being the dice roller grants no control of the NPC. Life resistance reduces healing normally. This may instead target a healing-harmed creature: the result becomes Life damage, with Fortitude defense if a player is defending for that creature and no extra opposed roll. Keep the same range, life cost and free-hand requirement. This can be repeated while affordable. Provokes as spellcasting; no separate spell slots.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.

**ID:** creature-adder


**Category:** Animal · **Role:** Venomous nuisance · **CV:** 5

**Difficulty rationale:** An agile or elusive body warrants attack Banes. Ordinary attack difficulty; riders and positioning carry the threat.

**Expected targets:** 1

*The blow lands with enough force to send its victim stumbling backward.*

**Target:** One adjacent creature. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** radiant.

**Weak defense:** Push 2. **Standard defense:** Push 1.

specialtyDetails.title: Cover a Companion
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Cover a Companion

*The guardian steps into the line of danger, making the attacker work around its raised guard.*

Before a visible enemy attacks a willing ally adjacent to this creature, impose 1 Bane on that attack roll if this creature can see the attacker. Against an NPC attack, grant that ally 1 Boon to its defense instead. This creature must also be adjacent to the attacker, or hold a shield the DA judges can obstruct the attack. No movement, target substitution or damage transfer. For a single player area attack, use the normal worst-target modifiers; do not roll again.

specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Warding Light

*A warm light settles over one companion like a hand on the shoulder.*

One willing ally within 3 squares reduces Frightened by 1. Until this creature’s next turn, that ally also has 1 Boon on its next defense against a mental attack; for an NPC ally, impose 1 Bane on that player attack. Consumed even if canceled; does not stack with itself.

### Scatter Embers

*A spray of glowing cinders hangs between the creature and its pursuer.*

One adjacent creature gains Burning 1. Once per turn; no immediate damage. The condition uses normal resistance and decay.

### Heated Hide

*The struck scales flare, and a lash of heat follows the retreating blade.*

After an adjacent attacker deals HP damage to this creature, spend Reaction to apply Burning 1 to that attacker. It is a condition, not a free attack, and cannot trigger this ability in return. No trigger when the incoming action is itself a free attack. Summoned forms never receive this Reaction.

specialtyDetails.title: Shambling Advance
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Shambling Advance

*The corpse lurches after the nearest warm body, dragging its ruined feet without ever looking away.*

Move up to 2 squares toward a visible living creature within 6 squares; its next attack against that creature before turn end imposes 1 additional Bane on the player defense. For a player-controlled creature, gain 1 attack Boon instead. It must end closer to that creature than it began. For this movement only, treat difficult ground as normal; pay other costs and provoke normally. One attack only; repeated uses do not stack. This grants no attack and cannot be used while movement is prevented.

specialtyDetails.title: Borrowed Face
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Borrowed Face

Take the appearance and voice of a person of the same footprint, until dismissed or reduced to 0 HP. Keep statistics and equipment; gain no memories, languages or powers. Suspicious examination uses normal player Reason. Direct sunlight prevents this ability and ends the disguise.

specialtyDetails.title: Recoil into Shadow
specialtyDetails.markdown:

*Its wounded outline stretches into the nearest shadow and runs along the dark edge of the room.*

After an attack resolves and deals HP damage to this creature, move up to 2 squares through connected dimly lit or dark squares without provoking. This creature must survive and remain capable. Pay normal terrain costs and obey occupancy; no passage through solid objects or automatic Hidden. No trigger from a free attack; no attack is granted.

*The skeleton lets its joints collapse, spilling loose bones beneath the passing blow.*

*The joints grind shut and the body becomes a single weight planted against the shove.*

specialtyDetails.title: Battle Mending

One adjacent living ally; free hand. Pay 3 HP first, bypass resistance, and remain above 0. A player rolls this creature’s Reason: Weak heals 5, Standard 10, Strong 15 HP. Life resistance reduces healing, minimum 1. This spell provokes. Against a healing-harmed target instead, use Fortitude defense: Weak takes 15, Standard 10, Strong 5 Life damage. specialtyDetails.title: Ancestor's warning
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Ancestor's warning

**Target:** One visible creature within 5 squares. **Player defense:** Reason. **Damage type:** mental.

**Weak defense:** Frightened 2 of this creature. **Standard defense:** Frightened 1 of this creature.

specialtyDetails.title: Keep the Rhythm
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Keep the Rhythm

*A familiar rhythm cuts through panic and brings one companion back to the moment.*

One willing ally within 3 squares that can hear it reduces either Frightened or Dazed by 1. Once per turn. This does not recalculate action categories already selected at turn start.

specialtyDetails.title: Rally at the Blow
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Rally at the Blow

*A sharp call catches the wounded companion's attention before pain can turn into panic.*

After a visible willing ally within 3 squares takes HP damage from an attack, reduce that ally's Frightened by 1 if it can hear this creature. Then give it 1 Boon on its next defense before the start of this creature's next turn; for an NPC ally impose 1 Bane on the corresponding player attack. The defense benefit is consumed on that roll even if canceled and does not stack with itself. No healing or action is granted.

**Target:** One adjacent creature. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** physical.

**Weak defense:** Prone.

specialtyDetails.title: Make Room
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Make Room

*A clipped order sends one companion into the opening before it closes.*

One willing active ally within 3 squares that can hear it may spend that ally’s Reaction to move up to 2 squares. Movement provokes normally and pays terrain costs. An uncommanded summon cannot act; summons have no Reaction to spend.

specialtyDetails.title: Rally at the Blow
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Rally at the Blow

*A sharp call catches the wounded companion's attention before pain can turn into panic.*

After a visible willing ally within 3 squares takes HP damage from an attack, reduce that ally's Frightened by 1 if it can hear this creature. Then give it 1 Boon on its next defense before the start of this creature's next turn; for an NPC ally impose 1 Bane on the corresponding player attack. The defense benefit is consumed on that roll even if canceled and does not stack with itself. No healing or action is granted.

**Target:** One visible creature within 3 squares. **Player defense:** Fortitude. **Damage type:** cold.

specialtyDetails.title: Flicker Aside
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Flicker Aside

*Its outline gutters like a flame in a draft and catches again just beyond the reaching hand.*

After an attack resolves and deals HP damage to this creature, teleport to a visible empty square within 1 square. This creature must survive and remain capable. The destination must support its footprint and be reachable by an unobstructed straight path; this does not pass through walls or occupied squares. No opportunity attacks from this teleport. No trigger from a free attack; no attack is granted.

specialtyDetails.title: Guide the Light
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Guide the Light

*A ribbon of lanternlight runs along the path, picking out each stone on the way to shelter.*

Brightly light up to 3 connected squares within 3 squares until the start of this creature's next turn. Requires an unobstructed path from this creature to each square; it may choose unlit squares. Ordinary darkness imposes no Boons or Banes for seeing those squares; cover, concealment and hiding still use the normal rules. This neither reveals Hidden creatures automatically nor penetrates opaque obstacles. Reusing this ability replaces its previous illuminated area.

*As the pursuer lunges into reach, it ducks sideways through the space the rush left open.*

After a visible enemy ends voluntary movement adjacent to this creature, move up to 1 square without provoking from that enemy. Other opportunity attacks and normal terrain costs apply. This movement grants no attack; it cannot trigger from forced movement or movement granted by a free attack.

specialtyDetails.title: Flicker Aside
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Flicker Aside

*Its outline gutters like a flame in a draft and catches again just beyond the reaching hand.*

After an attack resolves and deals HP damage to this creature, teleport to a visible empty square within 1 square. This creature must survive and remain capable. The destination must support its footprint and be reachable by an unobstructed straight path; this does not pass through walls or occupied squares. No opportunity attacks from this teleport. No trigger from a free attack; no attack is granted.

specialtyDetails.title: Stalking Step
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Stalking Step

*It folds into the broken light, leaving only a leaf moving where it stood.*

Move up to 2 squares without provoking from one visible enemy chosen before moving, ending in a square with cover or concealment from that enemy. Pay normal terrain costs and provoke normally from other enemies. Does not grant Hidden; a separate Hide action still needs concealment and a roll when uncertain.

*Its nose lifts, separating the sharp scent of fresh blood from the rest of the air.*

specialtyDetails.title: Follow the Pack
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Follow the Pack

*One hunter moves and another flows into its wake, tightening the circle without a sound.*

After a visible active ally ends voluntary movement adjacent to a visible enemy within 3 squares of this creature, move up to 2 squares, ending adjacent to that ally. Pay normal terrain costs and provoke normally. The ally must be conscious and not Paralyzed; an uncommanded summon cannot trigger this. No attack or command is granted, and movement granted by a free attack cannot trigger it.

specialtyDetails.title: Make Room
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Make Room

*A clipped order sends one companion into the opening before it closes.*

One willing active ally within 3 squares that can hear it may spend that ally’s Reaction to move up to 2 squares. Movement provokes normally and pays terrain costs. An uncommanded summon cannot act; summons have no Reaction to spend.

specialtyDetails.title: Rally at the Blow
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Rally at the Blow

*A sharp call catches the wounded companion's attention before pain can turn into panic.*

After a visible willing ally within 3 squares takes HP damage from an attack, reduce that ally's Frightened by 1 if it can hear this creature. Then give it 1 Boon on its next defense before the start of this creature's next turn; for an NPC ally impose 1 Bane on the corresponding player attack. The defense benefit is consumed on that roll even if canceled and does not stack with itself. No healing or action is granted.

specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Cover a Companion

*The guardian steps into the line of danger, making the attacker work around its raised guard.*

Before a visible enemy attacks a willing ally adjacent to this creature, impose 1 Bane on that attack roll if this creature can see the attacker. *Cracked ice bursts outward in a glittering spray that freezes across the attacker's skin.*

After an adjacent attacker's attack resolves and deals HP damage to this creature, apply Freezing 1 to that attacker. This creature must survive and remain capable. No trigger from a free attack or another retaliatory effect. This is a condition, not another attack.

*It sweeps a frozen hand across the ground, leaving raised crusts of ice that catch at hurried feet.*

Make up to 3 connected empty ground squares within 3 squares difficult terrain for everyone until the start of this creature's next turn. Requires a supporting surface. No entry damage, automatic fall or bridge over empty space. Reusing this ability replaces its previous patch.

specialtyDetails.title: Guiding ray
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Guiding ray

**Target:** One visible creature within 6 squares. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** radiant.

**Weak defense:** Blinded 2. **Standard defense:** Blinded 1.

specialtyDetails.title: Warding Light
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Warding Light

*A warm light settles over one companion like a hand on the shoulder.*

One willing ally within 3 squares reduces Frightened by 1. Until this creature’s next turn, that ally also has 1 Boon on its next defense against a mental attack; for an NPC ally, impose 1 Bane on that player attack. Consumed even if canceled; does not stack with itself.

specialtyDetails.title: Sheltering Light
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Sheltering Light

*Light gathers over a companion like overlapping feathers, taking the harsh edge from the impact.*

Before one visible willing ally within 3 squares takes damage from an attack, grant that ally Physical resistance 2 for that attack only. Use the highest matching resistance, not an added reduction; minimum damage rules remain. This does not heal, transfer damage or grant resistance to other types.

specialtyDetails.title: Guide the Light
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Guide the Light

*A ribbon of lanternlight runs along the path, picking out each stone on the way to shelter.*

Brightly light up to 3 connected squares within 3 squares until the start of this creature's next turn. Requires an unobstructed path from this creature to each square; it may choose unlit squares. Ordinary darkness imposes no Boons or Banes for seeing those squares; cover, concealment and hiding still use the normal rules. This neither reveals Hidden creatures automatically nor penetrates opaque obstacles. Reusing this ability replaces its previous illuminated area.

One adjacent living ally; free hand (the hart’s antlers provide this). Pay 3 HP first, bypass resistance, and remain above 0. A player rolls this creature’s Reason: Weak heals 5, Standard 10, Strong 15 HP. Life resistance reduces healing, minimum 1. This spell provokes. Against a healing-harmed target instead, use Fortitude defense: Weak takes 15, Standard 10, Strong 5 Life damage. Same cost; no healing riders.

specialtyDetails.title: Sheltering Light
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Sheltering Light

*Light gathers over a companion like overlapping feathers, taking the harsh edge from the impact.*

Before one visible willing ally within 3 squares takes damage from an attack, grant that ally Physical resistance 2 for that attack only. Use the highest matching resistance, not an added reduction; minimum damage rules remain. This does not heal, transfer damage or grant resistance to other types.

specialtyDetails.title: Warding Light
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Warding Light

*A warm light settles over one companion like a hand on the shoulder.*

One willing ally within 3 squares reduces Frightened by 1. Until this creature’s next turn, that ally also has 1 Boon on its next defense against a mental attack; for an NPC ally, impose 1 Bane on that player attack. Consumed even if canceled; does not stack with itself.

specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Rally at the Blow

*A sharp call catches the wounded companion's attention before pain can turn into panic.*

After a visible willing ally within 3 squares takes HP damage from an attack, reduce that ally's Frightened by 1 if it can hear this creature. Then give it 1 Boon on its next defense before the start of this creature's next turn; for an NPC ally impose 1 Bane on the corresponding player attack. specialtyDetails.title: Thunder staff

**Target:** One adjacent creature. **Player defense:** Fortitude. **Damage type:** physical.

specialtyDetails.title: Keep the Rhythm
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Keep the Rhythm

*A familiar rhythm cuts through panic and brings one companion back to the moment.*

One willing ally within 3 squares that can hear it reduces either Frightened or Dazed by 1. Once per turn. This does not recalculate action categories already selected at turn start.

specialtyDetails.title: Rally at the Blow
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Rally at the Blow

*A sharp call catches the wounded companion's attention before pain can turn into panic.*

After a visible willing ally within 3 squares takes HP damage from an attack, reduce that ally's Frightened by 1 if it can hear this creature. Then give it 1 Boon on its next defense before the start of this creature's next turn; for an NPC ally impose 1 Bane on the corresponding player attack. The defense benefit is consumed on that roll even if canceled and does not stack with itself. No healing or action is granted.

reference.flavorMarkdown: *A swollen walking corpse with stiff joints, torn clothing and grasping hands. It has little judgment, but enough dead weight and persistence to obstruct a narrow passage.*

specialtyDetails.title: Clutching hands
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Clutching hands

*A coil or grasping limb closes around the target and braces against its struggling weight.*

**Target:** One adjacent creature. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** physical.

**Weak defense:** Grappled 2. **Standard defense:** Grappled 1.

**Limit:** The holder suffers its own Grappled contribution. A new result replaces its lower contribution, not adds to it. Release freely; separation beyond reach, unconsciousness or death ends the hold.

specialtyDetails.title: Clinging Recoil
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Clinging Recoil

*A ruined hand closes on cloth and flesh even as the blow tears through the corpse.*

After an adjacent attacker’s attack resolves and deals HP damage to this creature, apply Slowed 2 to that attacker. This creature must survive and remain capable. No trigger from a free attack or another retaliatory effect. This grants no grapple, extra damage or equipment destruction.

specialtyDetails.title: Shambling Advance
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Shambling Advance

*The corpse lurches after the nearest warm body, dragging its ruined feet without ever looking away.*

Move up to 2 squares toward a visible living creature within 6 squares; its next attack against that creature before turn end imposes 1 additional Bane on the player defense. For a player-controlled creature, gain 1 attack Boon instead. It must end closer to that creature than it began. For this movement only, treat difficult ground as normal; pay other costs and provoke normally. One attack only; repeated uses do not stack. This grants no attack and cannot be used while movement is prevented.

specialtyDetails.title: Cover a Companion
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Cover a Companion

*The guardian steps into the line of danger, making the attacker work around its raised guard.*

Before a visible enemy attacks a willing ally adjacent to this creature, impose 1 Bane on that attack roll if this creature can see the attacker. Against an NPC attack, grant that ally 1 Boon to its defense instead. This creature must also be adjacent to the attacker, or hold a shield the DA judges can obstruct the attack. No movement, target substitution or damage transfer. For a single player area attack, use the normal worst-target modifiers; do not roll again.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Habitat:** House; ruin · **Communication:** Languages known in life

specialtyDetails.title: Hooked vine
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Hooked vine

*A hooked limb braces against the bank and heaves its catch toward the dark water.*

**Target:** One creature within 3 squares. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** physical.

**Weak defense:** Pull 2. **Standard defense:** Pull 1.

specialtyDetails.title: Root grip
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Root grip

*A coil or grasping limb closes around the target and braces against its struggling weight.*

**Target:** One adjacent creature. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** physical.

**Weak defense:** Grappled 2. **Standard defense:** Grappled 1.

**Limit:** The holder suffers its own Grappled contribution. A new result replaces its lower contribution, not adds to it. Release freely; separation beyond reach, unconsciousness or death ends the hold.

fields.label: Limit
fields.text: The holder suffers its own Grappled contribution. A new result replaces its lower contribution, not adds to it. Release freely; separation beyond reach, unconsciousness or death ends the hold.

specialtyDetails.title: Barbed Recoil
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Barbed Recoil

*The struck bough bends back, dragging a rake of hooked thorns across the hand that struck it.*

After an adjacent attacker's attack resolves and deals HP damage to this creature, apply Bleeding 1 to that attacker. This creature must survive and remain capable. No trigger from a free attack or another retaliatory effect. This is a condition, not another attack.

specialtyDetails.title: Hook the Retreat
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Hook the Retreat

*The hooked limb follows the withdrawing foe, catching just as the space opens between them.*

After a visible enemy voluntarily moves from adjacent to this creature and ends that movement exactly 2 squares from it, pull that enemy 1 square toward this creature along a clear path. Apply Stability, terrain costs and normal collision rules. No separate attack damage. Forced movement and movement granted by a free attack cannot trigger this; it is an alternative to spending the Reaction on an opportunity attack.

specialtyDetails.title: Weave the Roots
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Weave the Roots

*Roots braid themselves into firm footholds across the treacherous ground.*

Choose up to 3 connected difficult-terrain ground squares within 3 squares; they count as normal terrain until its next turn. Requires soil or living vegetation; cannot bridge empty space or bypass occupied squares.

*A whispered accusation rides the fading spell back toward the one who shaped it.*

After a spell attack resolves and deals HP damage to this creature, its visible caster within 6 squares gains Frightened 2 of this creature if the caster can hear it. This creature must survive and remain capable. No trigger from a free attack or another retaliatory effect. Frightened applies only while this creature is perceptible; the spell is not canceled.

specialtyDetails.title: Cover a Companion
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Cover a Companion

*The guardian steps into the line of danger, making the attacker work around its raised guard.*

Before a visible enemy attacks a willing ally adjacent to this creature, impose 1 Bane on that attack roll if this creature can see the attacker. Against an NPC attack, grant that ally 1 Boon to its defense instead. This creature must also be adjacent to the attacker, or hold a shield the DA judges can obstruct the attack. reference.flavorMarkdown: *A low, heavy wild pig covered in coarse bristles, with curved tusks and a thick shield of hide over its shoulders. Usually wary, it becomes fiercely direct when cornered or defending young.*

specialtyDetails.title: Tusks
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Tusks

*The blow lands with enough force to send its victim stumbling backward.*

**Target:** One adjacent creature. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** physical.

**Weak defense:** Push 2. **Standard defense:** Push 1.

specialtyDetails.title: Break the Approach
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Break the Approach

*It lashes out with shoulder or horn, spoiling the straight line of the charging foe.*

After a visible enemy ends voluntary movement adjacent to this creature, push that enemy 1 square directly away. Apply Stability, terrain costs and normal collision rules; no separate attack damage. Forced movement and movement granted by a free attack cannot trigger this.

reference.generalDetailsMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 1; an explicit creature trait, not a bonus from size.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Turned soil and bark stripped from the roots of trees.

**Purpose:** Keep a feeding patch or its young undisturbed.

**Tactics and retreat:** Charge the nearest intruder and use cover to stop pursuit.

**Counterplay and conversation:** A sturdy obstacle interrupts its approach; backing away from the young may end the danger.

**Habitat:** Wilderness · **Communication:** None

**Loot:** A hunter with the appropriate card can make use of the carcass.

**Summoning:** Animal 1 — [player reference](../summons/wild-boar.md).

specialtyDetails.title: Rime breath
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Rime breath

**Target:** All creatures in a cone of 3 rows, 1/3/5 squares wide; no exclusions. Each player rolls defense separately. **Player defense:** Fortitude. **Damage type:** cold.

**Weak defense:** Freezing 2. **Standard defense:** Freezing 1.

**Limit:** Cannot use this attack on consecutive turns, regardless of result.

specialtyDetails.title: Read the Blood Trail
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Read the Blood Trail

*Its nose lifts, separating the sharp scent of fresh blood from the rest of the air.*

Learn the direction of the nearest Bleeding creature within 6 squares. This does not reveal Hidden, give an exact square or permit a sight-required attack against an unseen target.

specialtyDetails.title: Follow the Pack
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Follow the Pack

*One hunter moves and another flows into its wake, tightening the circle without a sound.*

After a visible active ally ends voluntary movement adjacent to a visible enemy within 3 squares of this creature, move up to 2 squares, ending adjacent to that ally. Pay normal terrain costs and provoke normally. The ally must be conscious and not Paralyzed; an uncommanded summon cannot trigger this. No attack or command is granted, and movement granted by a free attack cannot trigger it.

specialtyDetails.title: Lay the Rime
specialtyDetails.markdown:
### Lay the Rime

*It exhales a low stream of white breath, crusting the ground with brittle ice in front of the pack.*

Make up to 3 connected empty ground squares within 3 squares difficult terrain for everyone until the start of this creature's next turn. Requires a supporting surface. No entry damage, automatic fall or bridge over empty space. Reusing this ability replaces its previous patch.
